observations: A solid black rounded figure with long ears sits centered on a flat teal ground, its body made of stacked lobed shapes with small teal curved lines at the sides suggesting arm outlines.
Two yellow double-loop eyes and a yellow W-shaped mouth mark the face; these are the only warm color in the image, pulling focus against the black silhouette.
Roughly twenty wavy black lines radiate outward from behind the figure across the teal background, varying from tight zigzags near the top to flatter waves at the sides.
reading: A black silhouette sits squat and still while wavy lines push outward from it in every direction. The yellow eyes—drawn as looping double rings—read as wide open, possibly alarmed, possibly fixed. The flat teal field gives the figure nowhere to recede into, and the radiating lines make the stillness feel charged rather than calm. The W mouth adds an ambiguous note: grimace or grin is hard to say.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the immediate title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #97 and nnxyz nnotb #99. Both use a rounded creature form with prominent eyes, but #97 works in dense layered gold tones and #99 in a hazy multicolor wash—this piece is the starkest of the three in palette and outline.

nnxyz nifty faces #75 shares the same teal background tone and uses bold outlined eye shapes as the dominant facial feature, offering a cross-collection contrast of how the same ground color frames very different mark densities.
